page_title: AUG 2-5 STU | Augsburg v Stuttgart 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The Stuttgart players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
86' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Dimitrios Giannoulis limps off the pitch to be replaced by Uchenna Ogundu (Augsburg).
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart) coming on for Deniz Undav.
83' 2 - 5 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) scores after an assist by Deniz Undav that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:5.
81' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Lorenz Assignon.
81' It will be a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Tiago Tomas walks off.
78' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
77' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
76' The attendance for today's match is 30660.
74' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
71' 2 - 4 Goal! Anton Kade (Augsburg) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:4.
70' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chris Fuhrich.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Chema Andres will be replaced by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).

69' What an opportunity! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

67' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
65' The substitution is prepared. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Han-Noah Massengo.

63' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Alexander Nubel keeps the ball out.
63' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) for his blatant foul. Augsburg are awarded the free kick.
61' Stuttgart are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
58' 1 - 4 After a goalmouth scramble the ball rebounds out to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) who buries it from close range into the left side of the goal.
57' 1 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:3.
55' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
54' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' The goalkeeper dives to deny Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manuel Baum gives a chance to Anton Kade (Augsburg) and Elvis Rexhbecaj is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Noahkai Banks will not participate anymore and Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) is coming on.
46' Manuel Baum has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) comes on the pitch for Rodrigo Ribeiro.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' A corner kick by Stuttgart is thwarted by the well prepared Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).
45+3' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' The Stuttgart players are stunned as referee Felix Zwayer changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
43' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Stuttgart, he's going to review using VAR.
43' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' The referee blows his whistle as Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Stuttgart.
41' Stuttgart keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
39' The foul by Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.

36' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

35' That didn't go as planned! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Alexander Nubel, who easily kept it out.
32' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
31' 0 - 3 Goal! Maximilian Mittelstadt passes the ball to the feet of Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:3.
29' 0 - 2 Goal! Nikolas Nartey tees up Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:2.
26' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
25' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
23' Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Zwayer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

19' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
19' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
16' Augsburg take a short corner kick.

14' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Zwayer with no other option than to blow for a foul.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
9' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

8' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
8' Stuttgart force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
5' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Stuttgart fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart win a corner kick.

3' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
